experiments.study_type: Hypoxic-hypercapnic (HH) gas challenge and ventilatory parameter assessment
experiments.procedure_text: Whole-body plethysmography was used to record ventilatory parameters in freely-moving rats after injection of vehicle or L,D-DTT and subsequent HH gas challenge for 60 min.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Whole-body plethysmography (PLY3223; Data Sciences International, St. Paul, MN, USA) was used to record ventilatory parameters in freely-moving rats... One group of rats (n = 6, 326 ± 2 g) received an injection of vehicle (100 μL/kg, IV) and another (n = 6, 327 ± 2 g) received an injection of L,D-DTT (100 μmol/kg, IV). After 15 min, both groups received a HH gas challenge for 60 min

endpoints.label: ventilatory parameters
endpoints.evidence: Whole-body plethysmography... was used to record ventilatory parameters in freely-moving rats

endpoints.label: body temperature
endpoints.evidence: We recorded rat body temperatures... via a rectal thermometer

exposure.conditions: HH gas challenge consisted of stopping the 1.5 mL/min flow of room air through the chambers for 60 min

experiments.exposure_evidence: After 15 min, both groups received a HH gas challenge for 60 min
experiments.regulatory_evidence: The experiments described in this manuscript were performed according to the NIH Guide... and to ARRIVE... guidelines.
experiments.notes: Two separate batches of 3 rats per group were used to help ensure reproducibility.
